Question: Will the Banco Central del Paraguay announce a payment start date for ueno bank CDA holders by 28 November 2026?

Today is 2026-11-18 18:58 UTC. The question closes 2026-11-18 21:43 UTC, 3 hours from now.

Background:
ueno bank S.A. is a Paraguayan bank whose failure triggered one of the largest banking resolutions in the country's history. On 2 November 2026 the Directorio of the Banco Central del Paraguay (BCP) ordered the start of resolution proceedings under Law 2334/2003, after the bank's solvency ratio fell below 50% of the legal minimum following adjustments to its financial statements.

Deposits are protected by the Fondo de Garantía de Depósitos (FGD) up to 75 monthly minimum wages per depositor, i.e. G. 228,300,000 (roughly US$37,000). After Congress passed Law 7745/26 (promulgated 4 November 2026), the BCP began paying an anticipo of up to 40 minimum wages (G. 121,760,000, about US$19,000) per depositor, net of overdue debts. Payments ran in successive tranches between 5 and 11 November. By 11 November the BCP said it had reached all 1,812,348 depositors entitled to the anticipo, disbursing about G. 3.9 trillion (roughly US$643–644 million) ([20minutos/EFE](https://www.20minutos.es/internacional/ueno-bank-completa-anticipo-todos-los-clientes-cubiertos-por-garantia-estatal_7060007_0.html); [Perspectivas](https://perspectivas.com.py/noticias/el-bcp-llego-al-100-de-los-ahorristas-de-ueno-pero-lo-mas-dificil-recien-empieza)). The FGD's calculated coverage for ueno bank is about US$740 million, so a further round is still needed to lift depositors with balances above G. 121,760,000 up to the G. 228,300,000 ceiling; the BCP said on 12 November that it would extend payments from the following week to complete the 75-wage limit, subject to finishing the bank's "balance de exclusión".

Certificados de Depósito de Ahorro (CDA) — savings certificates issued by the bank — have not yet been paid. The BCP says they require additional title verification, and on 12 November 2026 it opened a platform for CDA holders to validate ownership ([Última Hora](https://www.ultimahora.com/tenes-un-cda-en-ueno-esto-tenes-que-saber-para-recibir-el-reembolso-del-fdg); [ABC Color](https://www.abc.com.py/economia/2026/11/10/ueno-bank-como-se-recuperaran-los-cda-y-fondos-mutuos)). As of 13 November 2026 no payment date for CDA holders had been announced; FGD officials said CDA holders would be paid after the anticipo stage, and that CDA payment cannot rely on the same automated account data used for sight deposits.

Balances above the G. 228,300,000 cap have no automatic guarantee and would have to be recovered through liquidation of the bank's assets, a much slower path. Roughly US$2.8 billion in deposits sat at the intervened bank, and public and pension funds are heavily exposed — including about US$516 million of IPS social-security money. The crisis also toppled the government: President Santiago Peña left office on 5 November 2026 and Vice-President Pedro Alliana was sworn in as President on 6 November 2026 ([La Tribuna](https://www.latribuna.com.py/politica/2026/11/06/pedro-alliana-asume-la-presidencia-tras-la-destitucion-de-santiago-pena/)). Prosecutors have imputed dozens of people, and Congress is considering several Ueno-related bills.
